end_stability: requested path, resolved path, lstat and stat including inode/dev/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns; metadata only, no second content hash
read_cache: physical device/inode deduplication; failed partial reads also cannot be retried within the script
FullMember_if_found: Exact selected canonical record plus record-source bytes, first object hash identity, explicit JSON qualification/audit/receipt pointers only; no recursive contents or source imports
raw_files_emitted: selected FullMember source and explicit receipts plus original adoption bytes in in-memory xz tar; object content is hashed and not exported
overflow_behavior: Emit only exact first compressed prefix with original full archive length/SHA and explicit complete_archive_transmitted=false; exit4 and zero remote persistence. No complete-archive acceptance claim.
registry_absence_behavior: Exact key absent is explicit false and not a failure; unreadable/invalid registry is an error, not a claim that the module is absent.
static_check_execution: Only parsed source/wrapper AST and decoded wrapper locally; script itself was not run.
